expression_language: SymPy exact strings; ** powers; zeta(n); M_i_j and N_i_j are raw moments
normalization: Coefficient of lambda**3 times the displayed color in log(W); no repeated exponentiation, C4 or Euler factor

provenance.method: reconstruct compact post from selected poles and finite_MN; subtract independently rebuilt CT; divide S3 by exact coefficient recursion; verify every coefficient against original selected GPL
provenance.current_graph_connection: reused passing rg-replay; original argument-change canonicalization in workflow/checks/w3-ca-nf/physical.mpl

lower_orders.normalization: All displayed lower-order quantities have the common outer CF removed; existing S1/S2 are retained in w1/w2.

conversion_dictionary.expression_language: SymPy exact strings; ** powers; zeta(n); M_i_j and N_i_j are raw moments
conversion_dictionary.domain: z>0; rho=log(z); L=(L_s+L_t)/2; L_s=L+rho/2 and L_t=L-rho/2

moments.index_domain: i>=0, j>=1; no factorial denominators; removable point beta=r_z

hlog.word_order: first letter is outermost; empty word is 1
hlog.branch: real z>0; continuation outside this domain requires the source branch prescription
hlog.symbol_encoding: H_z_m1_0_0 denotes Hlog(z,[-1,0,0]); all-zero words are replaced by rho**n/n!

normalization.logZ: negative-power coefficients of log(Z4), with epsilon-zero entry explicitly 0

conversion_dictionary.scope: Three matter color totals through eps^0 only. This is not a universal Hlog-to-M/N reduction of individual diagrams or an all-order closure claim.

reused_rg_replay.role: current 31-graph Af source connection and existing RG checks, reused with all source hashes rechecked

verification.scope: Exact algebra, selected-expression conversions and compact-stage reconstruction; not independent proofs of original integrals or external noncusp/finite-shape verification.

limitations: The pure CF*CA**2 channel is outside this export.
Af compact raw/bare series are reconstructed and checked, not a newly independent graph integration.
The external noncusp scale dictionary remains unresolved; internal gamma4=2*h is preserved.
A compact color total does not prove each individual diagram has an M/N representation.
